newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firmer as swaps make $5 gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firmer as swaps make $5 gains.

text.p: NWE naphtha was notionally firmer with swaps gains on Monday, but an illiquid physical market left traders divided over price levels.
Several pegged physical prices some $5 higher, to account for gains in the swaps market.
"It was pushed down last week without any trade," said one.
This view was confirmed by an offer of a Suez cargo at $227 cif NWE and a trading house bid at $225.
But other traders said with limited end-user demand the market had no reason to retrace last week's losses, which took quotes down to $220. -Rosalind Russell, London +44 171 542 5387
